articles.summary: Key Takeaways The J.M. Smucker Co. portfolio features brands consumers love across coffee, pet, and snacking. The portfolio of leading brands has always delivered on the needs and preferences of consumers and continues to do so this fall with new flavors and formats celebrating all things autumn. Brands including Hostess® snacks, Milk-Bone® dog treats, and Uncrustables® sandwiches have seasonally inspired offerings, now available. ORRVILLE, Ohio , Sept. 25, 2026 / PRNewswire / - The J.M. Smucker Co. (NYSE: SJM ) has established a legacy of nearly 130 years by delivering on the needs of consumers and being there for every occasion. While the fall season officially began on September 22, consumers' celebration of all things' autumn has been in full swing, and the Smucker portfolio is doing its part.
